title: Extra technicians show as +N and every name can be found by hovering
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 6 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards", "Dana Ortiz", "Jenny Wilson", "Kristin Watson", "Theresa Webb"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Theresa Webb") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. Create an Approved work order for the case customer with Lead Technician "Esther Howard" and five lines, each given to a different technician: Ralph Edwards, Dana Ortiz, Jenny Wilson, Kristin Watson, Theresa Webb (6 people).
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; in the design its button tooltip reads "Board").
  2. Type the case customer's name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") in Search.
  3. Turn line technicians on in Fields to display.
  4. Count the avatars shown and read the +N indicator.
  5. Hover each visible avatar, one at a time, and read the name shown.
  6. Hover the +N indicator and read what it shows.
  7. Pick Tech View with Assigned Techs on and repeat steps 4 to 6.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If not all 6 fit, the first avatars are shown followed by +N, and shown avatars + N = 6 (e.g. 4 avatars and "+2").
  • Hovering an avatar shows that avatar's own name, only while the pointer is on that avatar.
  • Every one of the 6 technicians can be found by name, including those behind +N (e.g. hovering +2 lists Kristin Watson and Theresa Webb).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10050 (Story 7, Show line technicians on cards and rows); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S7-R4, S7-R6, S7-R2, read 8 Oct 2026. Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html) / design system TechStack: up to 5 avatars, else 4 avatars + "+N"; hovering +N lists the hidden names. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R4: “When avatars exceed available space, show the first avatars followed by a +N overflow indicator.”
  • S7-R6: “Keep every involved technician discoverable by name.”
  • S7-R2: “Use each visible avatar’s own visible area as its hover target.”
